===Mat and Perrin meeting===
I've figured for a while now that Mat and Perrin are going to reunite, for the first time since the stone, very soon, considering that they're in quite close proximity to each other. 
But its interesting to think about the repercussions of such a meeting,
:* Mat doesn't know about the whole "Lord of the Two Rivers" thing, and well we never saw them together much since Falmn so we have no idea how they'll be together.
:* Morgase is with Perrin and Mat is one of the few who could recognise her, and who knows what that whould do.
:* Abell Cauthorn is also with Perrin, that could be an amusing reunion.
